company.name: Paragonel
company.description: Paragonel is an AI-native product-engineering company. We build our own SaaS products (AcquisitionOS, SystemFoundry, CodeGuard AI) and deliver custom digital platforms and engineering services. We specialize in AI integration, cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, and full-stack product engineering.
company.mission: To eliminate the gap between business problems and working solutions by building AI-native software that actually solves real pain.
company.vision: To make AcquisitionOS the operating system its customers use to run client acquisition end-to-end, and to let our engineering services practice feed and be fed by that product work.

founder_details.background: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science. Specialist Java Backend Developer with experience building massive-scale systems at Netcore Cloud, handling millions of real-time events.

products.name: AcquisitionOS
products.description: An AI-native client acquisition operating system that unifies prospect discovery, research, gap detection, opportunity reporting, scoring, personalized outreach, reply handling, meeting workflows, pipeline management, and proposal generation into a single connected workflow. Currently in private beta.

products.name: SystemFoundry
products.description: A visual simulator for cloud systems that projects costs and identifies bottlenecks before deployment. Used internally for Paragonel's cloud engineering work.

products.name: CodeGuard AI
products.description: Real-time cloud cost intelligence for developers, providing feedback on Terraform and CloudFormation files. Published on the VS Code Marketplace.

services.name: AI Solutions & LLM Ops
